text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Long live the Emperor! Long<n>live the
Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer... These cheers. Are they...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see... So I won.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So in the zone you didn't even realize<n>it? That's
unlike you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But you know, you look pretty rad<n>when you're
following your heart! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I could not have achieved such focus<n>against
anybody else. I enjoyed<n>myself so much because
it was you I<n>was racing against.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you can't drop a line like that<n>when you
just made me eat your<n>dust.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah. Well, allow me to rephrase.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Maruzensky. You were<n>quarry fit for
an Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still with the hunting stuff? Lame-o!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... Forgive me. I couldn't<n>resist.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll let you off the hook. But only<n>'cause of
that cute smile.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hasta la vista, Emperor. But you'd<n>better watch
your back, or next time I<n>really will gobble you up!
♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah... Next time, she says.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if there is a next time, I doubt<n>I'll be able to
run like I did today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's strange. I feel like I became one<n>with the race
itself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This race should have required all of<n>my
concentration and<n>resourcefulness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But all I could think about was the joy<n>of it. The
wind on my face, the<n>movements of the racers,
the<n>pounding of my feet on the track...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was... fun. A lot of fun. Perhaps the<n>most fun
I've ever had while racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And it's all because you encouraged<n>me to
compete as I truly am.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You helped me recall the primal desire<n>that draws
all Umamusume to the<n>track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see now that racing is enjoyable for<n>its own
sake... And at the end of a<n>race well run, there lies
bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want all Umamusume to feel the joy<n>I feel right
now. And so I shall hold<n>my ideals high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now more than ever, I must strive<n>toward those
ideals with all my might.<n>And that is why I require
your help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After all, it's not only Umamusume<n>who can show
the world the joy of<n>racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Will you stay by my side, Trainer? Will<n>you
continue to indulge this wild<n>dream of mine?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I gaze into Symboli Rudolf's eyes<n>and see the
resolve therein, I realize<n>that here, now, I'm
witnessing the<n>birth of the true Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Click! Flash! Click!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf! How do you feel<n>about your
victory?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It seems the press is calling. Perfect<n>timing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind gathering the<n>reporters? I would
like to start the<n>press conference right away.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, ladies and gentlemen. I<n>hope you will
forgive my formalities.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I come before you today to tell you<n>about the
Emperor's dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to create a world where<n>all
Umamusume can live in bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Many look down on this ideal. "How<n>can you
make everybody happy?"<n>they spit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What can one person do alone? they<n>sneer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Who will follow a half-grown<n>monarch? they scoff.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For years now, I have striven to<n>personally prove
those doubts false.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Only now do I understand that I was<n>wrong.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I cannot make everybody happy... Imust trust in everyone's capacity towin happiness for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Nor can I accomplish anything alone...<n>I must trust
in the comrades who<n>stand by my side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, nobody will follow<n>a half-grown
monarch. That is why I<n>must first have absolute
faith in my<n>own path.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let me speak now to you—you<n>beyond the screen,
listening to or<n>reading these words—you whom
perhaps I will one day meet<n>face-to-face.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My name is Symboli Rudolf, the<n>Emperor, and
today I have taken my<n>place as the greatest of all
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the crowns I have won, I swear to<n>be true to
your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And to those who seek glory, I bid<n>you, come
before my throne.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will welcome your challenge with<n>open arms.
